name: a8csp-background-tasks-engine
description: A background-work engine for WordPress sites: Tasks, Schedules, and Batches using Action Scheduler when available, with a documented best-effort WP-Cron fallback.

scripts.test:integration: wp-env --config .wp-env.tests.json run cli --env-cwd=wp-content/plugins/a8csp-background-tasks-engine php tests/complete-as-migration.php && wp-env --config .wp-env.tests.json run cli --env-cwd=wp-content/plugins/a8csp-background-tasks-engine vendor/bin/phpunit --testsuite=Integration
scripts.test:degraded: wp-env --config .wp-env.degraded.json run cli --env-cwd=wp-content/plugins/a8csp-background-tasks-engine wp eval 'if ( class_exists( "ActionScheduler" ) || function_exists( "as_enqueue_async_action" ) ) { WP_CLI::error( "Degraded integration requires Action Scheduler to be absent; remove every Action Scheduler plugin mapping and activation." ); }' && wp-env --config .wp-env.degraded.json run cli --env-cwd=wp-content/plugins/a8csp-background-tasks-engine vendor/bin/phpunit --testsuite=Integration --group=degraded
scripts.test:multisite: (wp-env --config .wp-env.multisite.json run cli --env-cwd=wp-content/plugins/a8csp-background-tasks-engine wp core multisite-convert || wp-env --config .wp-env.multisite.json run cli --env-cwd=wp-content/plugins/a8csp-background-tasks-engine wp core is-installed --network) && wp-env --config .wp-env.multisite.json run cli --env-cwd=wp-content/plugins/a8csp-background-tasks-engine wp plugin activate --network action-scheduler a8csp-background-tasks-engine && wp-env --config .wp-env.multisite.json run cli --env-cwd=wp-content/plugins/a8csp-background-tasks-engine php tests/complete-as-migration.php && wp-env --config .wp-env.multisite.json run cli --env-cwd=wp-content/plugins/a8csp-background-tasks-engine vendor/bin/phpunit --testsuite=Integration --group=multisite
